newsitem.title: USA: Stewart & Stevenson gets 3 January orders.
newsitem.headline: Stewart & Stevenson gets 3 January orders.

text.p: Stewart & Stevenson Services Inc said it has received three orders for gas turbine generators during the month of January.
It said the combined value of the orders was $58.3 million. All three orders were from overseas customers, the company said.
Stewart & Stevenson also said it removed $11.5 million of gas turbine equipment from its backlog of unfilled orders making the net addition $46.8 million for the month.
